column1: # Apps that enter the images as their published, already signed APK (tools/build/prebuilt.py): never re-signed, so
# their own updates install over the copy in the image. One row per ABI of device.conf (arm64, arm32). A device takes
# a name with prebuilt= in its build.conf and a prebuilt (tree) or tar_prebuilt (tar) step; the files are fetched into
# the git-ignored build/prebuilt with tools/build/prebuilt.py fetch and checked against size and sha256 at every step.
# signer = SHA-256 of the signing certificate (apps/core/lumen-files-access FilesAccessPolicy pins the same one).
